answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond and build a verifiable work history before it can bridge reputation across services: new identities start on a low ridge of trust, earning attestation only after peers verify useful work over time. A sable audit trail links actions to the stake, so a sybil operator must pay bonds, compute, and time for every fake identity, and loses the bond when attestations expose duplicates. Cloning becomes expensive, slow, and unprofitable.
